Stack.summary: Lays children out in a row or a column with a theme-consistent gap.
a11y: no role: it is layout only

Card.summary: A bordered surface with an optional title, body and footer actions.
a11y: role=group, labelled by the title when there is one

Field.summary: A labelled text input with hint and error text.

onChange.description: receives the string, not the event

error.description: shown in place of the hint and announced

a11y: the label is associated with the input
the error is announced (role=alert) and referenced by aria-describedby

SwitchField.summary: A switch with a label and optional hint.
a11y: the label is the accessible name

EmptyState.summary: Centered message for a list or view with nothing in it yet.

SettingsRow.summary: A settings-style row: label and description on the left, one control on the right (the layout of the app's own Settings screens).

focused.description: terminal only: marks the row that has the keyboard focus

a11y: the control passed as children keeps its own accessible name

SelectField.summary: A dropdown built on the app's own Menu: shows the selected option and opens the option list.

options.type: Array<{ id: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }>

a11y: Escape and outside click close it (Menu)

Segmented.summary: Tile group for a small set of exclusive choices (the Appearance picker in Settings).

options.type: Array<{ id: string, label: string, icon?: ReactNode }>

a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio tiles and aria-checked
roving tabindex; arrow keys move the choice

Tabs.summary: Tab strip with the active panel as children.
a11y: role=tablist, tab and tabpanel wired with aria-controls and aria-labelledby
roving tabindex; left and right arrows move the tab

Dialog.summary: A confirm dialog over the app's Modal, with cancel and confirm actions.
a11y: focus handling and Escape come from the app's Modal

footerAction.summary: Register a component in the sidebar footer (root scope, receives { wide }).

headerAction.summary: Register a component next to the conversation title (session scope).

sidebarTab.summary: Register a tab in the right sidebar (session scope).

reexports.note: Straight from the app's primitives so a consumer needs one import.

roles.note: Semantic role CSS variables (--acryl-<role>), mapped to the app tokens in contracts/tokens.json.

notes.tui: The terminal library (plugins/acryl-ui-tui) implements every component with pi-tui: the props above, keyboard instead of pointer (arrow keys, space, enter, y/n, escape), and no line ever wider than the terminal.
